title: OpenStax publisher lexicon (Layer 3)
description: Publisher-specific marker strings -> Layer-2 instructional-profile roles for OpenStax-shaped open textbooks. Layer 3 of the universal block-label ontology: this is the ONLY layer where publisher-specific marker vocabulary is allowed to live (wide-net rule: publisher vocabulary is DATA, never code). Matching is case-insensitive PREFIX on the block's leading text.
$comment: Marker set lifted from align_gold.py PRACTICE_MARKER_LEXICON['openstax'] + the SemantiK open-textbook overlay (schemas/taxonomies/semantik_lexicon.json). 'try it is something that only really appears in openstax texts' (owner 2026-07-13) — so it is confined here, not in the generic lexicon. Roles reference genre_profile_instructional.json.

x-markers.notes: immediate-practice prompt after a worked example; e.g. 'TRY IT :: 1.173'
